findings.title: DNS publication step is mislabeled as resolver receipt using cached keys

Actual producer dnssecSigningSession.publishAnswer updates published generation and calls a.publish with from=to=dnsProviderB. The step presentation is built from send operations. A resolver receipt/cache-selection explanation belongs to another owner; it cannot replace publication here.
